verdict.rationale: Trivy is designed as a CLI binary usable in scripts/CI, with documented --exit-code gating, JSON output, and container/binary distribution (brew, docker) confirmed by hands-on probes showing successful headless scans (trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret --exit-code 1 --format json). Community feedback corroborates ease of CI/CD integration, though some note bugs and a supply-chain compromise incident affecting trust in automated pipeline usage.
